blurb:
Spend 4 hours seeing the city’s highlights, including your pickup and drop off. Your first stop at Griffith Observatory is nestled on Mount Hollywood. Griffith Observatory has some of the best views of the city. It has a planetarium and various exhibits. Take as many videos and pictures as you'd like. 

Your driver guide will then take you to the Getty Museum where you can spend 2 hours exploring the museum and modern outdoor sculptures.
